approved_services: Refrigerated / cold-chain transportation in Saudi Arabia
target_industries_for_outreach: Food importers and distributors operating within Saudi Arabia
writing_rules: Target industries are audiences to speak to, NOT proof that Logistech already serves them. Write 'if your business handles X' instead of 'we serve X'.
Never state fleet size, number of trucks, certifications, clients, partners, coverage areas, temperature ranges, delivery times, prices or achievements unless listed in approved_facts.
Educational cold-chain content is allowed if it is generally true and not presented as a Logistech claim.
